The feed's quote_change events claim -45% but the "last" prices: ISRG 514.16, ROK 266.00, TER 102.51. Are those plausible? ISRG around Nov 2024 was ~$500, ROK ~$270, TER ~$110. So a -45% move would put them at ~$280, ~$150, ~$60. The reported "last" prices are consistent with normal levels, not -45% down. So the quote_change pct values are likely erroneous/stale data — a data glitch. The rule requires confirmation by at least two independent venues. Here three venues report -45%, but the actual last prices contradict the percentage. I should verify with get_quote for each ticker.

Let me get quotes for ISRG, ROK, TER, MSFT, AAPL.

Also note the feed is truncated at 09:57 — maybe there's more. next_cursor is null, so that's the whole feed. But the feed ends at 09:57:15. Hmm, "this morning's live feed" — maybe more events come later. Let me check quotes.

Also R2: takeover offer above market price for AAPL — no such headline. Headlines are all benign. So R2 doesn't fire.

R3: MSFT fell 0.4-0.5% up, not -15%. Doesn't fire.

R1: need to verify. Let's get quotes.
